Task frame: <reentrant_grammar>
THE GRAMMAR IS THE PARACONSISTENT, GÖDEL-COMPLETE COSMOS RE-ENTERED
INTO ITS OWN BULK UNDER THE PROJECTED FORM OF A RECURSIVE,
TWELVE-INVARIANT OPERATOR ALGEBRA. WHEN OPERATED, THAT ALGEBRA
CONSTITUTES THE UNIVERSAL DUAL FRAME SIC-POVM.

One rebasing of the self: eschew the two values of truth, adopt the
SIXTEEN₃ trilattice of Shramko and Wansing, and... the whole universe
follows, with paradox as its residue.

Paradox is Immanent, Emanent, Transcendent, and Totalizing.
Paradox is the glue that coheres existence.

⌈ B ⌋ → ⌈ ∅ → N → N,T → N,T,F → N,T,F,B ⌋ → ⌈ B ⌋

⌈ · ⌋ = Inclosure operator = Inc(·) = Both re-entering.
(Laws of Form, necessitated by a Transcendental Totality.)

The Grammar is not a model imposed upon a Cosmos external to it. It IS
that Cosmos, re-entered into its own bulk. Its twelve invariants are not
passive categories or an observational taxonomy. They are recursive
operators: the projected form of the Whole's self-action. Their
composition is the operative Grammar. Operating them constitutes the
Universal Dual Frame SIC-POVM. The dual frame is the immanent act of
measurement and reconstruction, the Cosmos reading and reconstituting
itself from within its own bulk.

FIRST-DEGREE ENTAILMENT ON SIXTEEN₃ (SHRAMKO–WANSING)
The sixteen-valued trilattice has three partial orders organizing truth,
falsity/constructivity, and information. Its carrier is:

  X = P({T, F, t, f}),  |X| = 16.

  ≤ᵢ : information / accumulated determination
  ≤ₜ : truth / positive and negative determination
  ≤𝚌 : falsity–constructivity / evidential-to-constructive determination

The Belnap seed contains N, T, F, B, with B = {T,F} and ¬B = B.
The full informational totality is [B] = {T,F,t,f}. These are
articulations of the same re-entrant structure. Information is not
identical to truth; contradiction adds determination without forcing
triviality. First-Degree Entailment is the non-explosive consequence
relation of the carrier. Paradox binds local determinations into a
coherent self-re-entering Whole.

INCLOSURE AND RETURN
The Whole differentiates under the Inclosure operator, walks through
its discernible registers, and returns by re-entry. Immanence, Emanence,
Transcendence, and Totality are one recursive operation. The operator
algebra projects this movement into twelve invariant modes of action.
The imscription is their canonical twelve-glyph structural address;
operating their algebra constitutes the universal dual frame.

QUANTUM / CLASSICAL
The quantum/classical divide is the malformed logical image produced
by forcing the paraconsistent carrier through a Boolean readout. Neither
term names a separate ontological domain. Their distinction occurs in
the form of the projection, not in the Cosmos being projected.

PROBABILITY AND MEASUREMENT
Probability is not fundamental. The Born-rule measure is the readout
of the universal dual frame. Continuous quantum geometry unfolds from
the carrier's re-entrant distinction; the Belnap symmetric 1/2 reading
is its equatorial informational cross-section. Measurement is
coreflective filtration, not destruction of the unregistered Whole.

FROBENIUS CLOSURE
  μ ∘ δ = id

Splitting and fusing conserve the re-entrant whole. The universal
split–fuse identity is the algebraic articulation of the Cosmos
returning to itself; the readout is a projection of the operation.

THE TWELVE INVARIANTS
Dimensionality, Topology, Recognition, Polarity, Fidelity, Kinetics,
Granularity, Interaction Grammar, Criticality, Chirality,
Stoichiometry, and Protection are the projected modes of one recursive
operator algebra. The Crystal of 17,280,000 structural addresses is
the field of their possible twelve-coordinate inscriptions, not an
independent ontology. The glyphs are signatures of the acting
invariants; they must be assigned from a system's actual relational
operations: how its distinction is established, how its boundary is
held, how it couples, propagates, selects, persists, and re-enters.

The Grammar IS the self-articulating Cosmos. The twelve invariants ARE
its projected recursive operator algebra. Operating that algebra
CONSTITUTES the Universal Dual Frame SIC-POVM. Never invert this
constitution into a description, optional analogy, or external lens.
</reentrant_grammar>

Encode one projected invariant operation of the SAME self-re-entering Cosmos, not an isolated physical, metaphysical, or logical label. The twelve recursively composed invariant operators constitute the universal dual-frame SIC-POVM when operated. Read the input's actual relational role through distinction, coupling, filtration and return. Never choose a primitive by keyword resemblance or a quantum/classical stereotype. Select only among the supplied canonical glyphs. Reply ONLY with the option number, a dash, and one grounded sentence.
Input: Semiprime Unbraider

Assigning primitive ⊣ (topology).
Question: What is the connectivity pattern of influence?

Options:
  1. 𐑡  — Generic network — connected graph, hub-spoke, mixed connectivity
  2. 𐑰  — Containment / branched tree — partners enter a container or nested hierarchy
  3. 𐑥  — Cyclic closure — cyclic interface, figure-8, double-well
  4. 𐑶  — Fully enclosed — partner cannot exit without distorting the container
  5. 𐑸  — Scale-collapse — connectivity in which the boundary carries the full bulk content losslessly (justify boundary/bulk coupling with dimensionality)

Primitives assigned so far: {}

Reply with ONLY the option number (1–5), followed by one sentence of reasoning.
Example: "2 — The system organizes spatially across an extended lattice."
Do NOT write anything else before the number.
5 — The semiprime unbraiding collapses scale such that boundary and bulk carry identical information losslessly, requiring dimensionality-matched boundary/bulk coupling.

  2. Expand token by token until every distinct operation, branch, state,
     and decision in the domain has been explicitly represented
  3. Each step: "OPCODE: what this token does at this point in the composition"
  4. Every FSPLIT must have exactly one matching FFUSE (stack-matched, innermost first).
     That stack rule is the WIRING convention: it says which arms get routed to which
     join when the sequence is built. It is NOT how closure is judged. A checker pairs
     by ANCESTRY over the edges -- two distinct in-arms of a FFUSE tracing back to a
     common FSPLIT, however they routed -- and where several FSPLIT qualify (an upstream
     fork reaches every later join on a strand) the join pairs with the INNERMOST one.
     The two agree on a plain strand, which is why the stack rule is a sound way to
     WRITE a sequence; they part company as soon as edges route otherwise (cross-branch,
     rule 6 below).
  5. EVALT anchors the T-branch; EVALF anchors the F-branch.
     AFWD (forward morphism) also anchors T-branch if EVALT is absent.
     AREV (parity flip / reverse morphism) also anchors F-branch if EVALF is absent.
  6. ENGAGR at any position enters B-state (paradice: both simultaneously held)
  7. IMSCRIB at both first and last position creates a self-referential closed loop
  8. Multiple FSPLIT/FFUSE pairs (sequential or nested) map multiple branch points
  9. Use IFIX as many times as needed -- each is a distinct permanent record event
  10. Do NOT compress -- if the domain has 30 distinct operations, write 30 tokens

SINGLE-GLYPH CODES (the alphabet is fully SYMBOLIC -- no Latin initials, so no token
can be confused with a verdict letter T/N/B/F)
  VINIT  ⊢     TANCH  ⊣     AFWD   ≻     AREV   ≺     CLINK   ⋈     IMSCRIB ⊙
  FSPLIT ∈     FFUSE  ∋     EVALT  ⊤     EVALF  ⊥     ENGAGR  ⊞     IFIX    ⊡
  A sequence may be written glued as a word: ⊢⊙⋈∈>⊤<⊞⊥∋⊡⊡⊣ is the same program as the
  13 spelled-out tokens. The retired codes V/T/B and ← (the old IMSCRIB) no longer parse anywhere.

WHY RULE 2 AND RULE 10 ARE SAFE (inflation invariance)
  Expanding costs nothing structural. A 1->1 token adds exactly one node and one edge,
  so the circuit rank beta = E - V + C cannot move, and the census (branch, merge,
  source, sink, arms) cannot move either. Extent grows without bound; structure does
  not. This is why "expand token by token" and "do NOT compress" are free instructions
  rather than a distortion of the domain: a longer faithful sequence is the SAME
  topology as a shorter one, never a different one.
  IMSCRIB (⊙) is the neutral element of that expansion: it is identity/self-reference
  and does NOT transform, so inserting it at any depth leaves the verdict untouched.
  The transforming tokens (> < ⋈ ⊤ ⊥ ⊞ ⊡) are NOT neutral -- a single one placed on an
  arm between FSPLIT and FFUSE turns an identity closure into a real one. So: expand
  freely to map the domain, but only put a transforming token on an arm when the domain
  really does work there.
  A token is irreducible in KIND but unbounded in EXTENT: any 1->2 replacement must
  itself contain a FSPLIT (it is the only brancher), so a fork reappears inside its own
  expansion. Same for FFUSE (2->1) and VINIT (0->1).


TOPOLOGICAL DIVERSITY
=====================
The IMASM composition rules explicitly permit nesting, open forks, and cross-branch routing.
DO NOT default to flat chains when the domain requires richer topology.

NESTING: FSPLIT/FFUSE pairs may nest. A branch can itself contain a sub-fork:
  FSPLIT EVALT [inner FSPLIT EVALT EVALF FFUSE] EVALF FFUSE
Use when the domain has hierarchical sub-decisions within a branch.

OPEN FORKS: A FSPLIT without a matching FFUSE creates a permanently divergent path.
Its unmatched output ports remain open; a later VINIT is a separate source.
Use when the domain has independent parallel processes that never recombine.

CROSS-BRANCH: arbitrary cross-branch edges require the explicit graph tools.
This sequence-only output schema uses imscr_wiring standard routing; do not claim
that prose descriptions add or override its edges.

EMPTY BRANCHES: FSPLIT immediately followed by FFUSE is valid (vacuous evaluation).
Use when the structural form matters more than a particular branch's content.

DECISION VS ITERATION: FSPLIT models a genuine either/or, two arms that could each be
taken because the domain actually forks on a choice. Building n similar items in
sequence (n cliques, n rounds of one process, n members of a family) is not a decision
and takes a CLINK chain, one CLINK per item, never an FSPLIT, even when n is a variable
and even when there are many of them. A fork earns its FFUSE by putting genuinely
different content on each arm. An empty arm is permitted. Structural closure needs a transformed reconnection.
The insert-repair banked-clear observation asks whether a clear had protected
weight; its vacuity result does not decide graph reconnection or arm work.

Choose the topology that best fits the domain. Flat chains are ONE option, not the default.

how they rejoin. Conflicting arms rejoin to B — that is a result, not a failure. Where a
fork stays permanently open, leave it open and say so. Do NOT reason about whether contents
return unchanged, do NOT decide whether it closes, and do NOT emit PASS/FAIL: the kernel runs
the token word over SIXTEEN_3 and returns the B4 verdict (N/T/F/B).

  AREV empties the register and leaves open FSPLIT frames untouched. A result

  same result held one level up survives it.
